faq-item.faq-q: What is the difference between an OpenAI API developer and a general AI developer?
faq-item.faq-a: An OpenAI API developer specializes in API integration, authentication, prompt engineering, rate limiting, and handling production-scale latency. A general AI developer may cover a broader range including model training, computer vision, or MLOps. For a project focused on reliable, cost-effective API integration, a specialist brings deeper, more focused expertise.

faq-item.faq-q: How much does it cost to hire a freelance OpenAI API developer?
faq-item.faq-a: A scoped proof-of-concept typically starts at $1,500 to $4,000. A full production API integration with error handling and deployment ranges from $8,000 to $30,000 depending on complexity and data volume. Hourly consulting runs $75 to $150/hr.

faq-item.faq-q: Should I hire one freelance OpenAI API developer or a dedicated team?
faq-item.faq-a: For a single, well-scoped API integration, one experienced freelance developer is typically faster to start and more cost-effective. If your roadmap spans multiple concurrent AI disciplines and needs sustained, embedded team capacity, a dedicated team provider like AtlasML is better matched to that scale.

faq-item.faq-q: How long does it take to build an OpenAI API integration?
faq-item.faq-a: A proof-of-concept typically takes 2 to 4 weeks. A full production API integration with error handling and deployment typically takes 4 to 10 weeks depending on the number of endpoints and integration scope.

faq-item.faq-a: Primarily LangChain, LangGraph, and LlamaIndex, combined with custom retry and logging logic matched to your scale and reliability requirements. See the OpenAI API integration services page for how the framework choice is made.
